messages:
elaine (partnerships): Brainstorm: "SI Accelerator" pilot — 7-day fast sandbox, short cert, marketplace quick-list. Objective: get SIs to first customer-ready demo in one week. Thoughts?
vy (solutions): Love it. Keep cohort small (6-8). Two focus tracks: infra and application.
mike (training): I can build a compact cert: 2 modules + 1 practical (deploy + run smoke eval). Badge minted on pass.
sudha (ops): We can do ephemeral sandboxes with caps. Need intake form fields: org, contact, cost_center. Manual provisioning first run.
liam (marketplace): Marketplace quick-listing should be a single YAML + one-pager. Want a verified-benchmarks checkbox.
elaine (partnerships): HW partners: can we get 4 reserved nodes for the week? Also, partner quote for the announcement.
infra-bot: infra ticket created: PARTNERS-4221 (reserve nodes)
vy (solutions): Add guidance on fallback: what to do if dedicated nodes are busy — recommend a smaller quantized model on hosted.
mike (training): Practical rubric: infra deploy (50%), smoke perf check (30%), demo recording (20%). Allow one remediation attempt.
sudha (ops): Action: I'll run manual provisioning playbook for first cohort. Automate in follow-ups.
liam (marketplace): I'll draft YAML template and blurb for marketing.
elaine (partnerships): Timeline: prep this week, cohort next week. Owners: Mike cert, Sudha provisioning, Liam listing, Vy SI list. 15-minute kickoff Mon.\vy (solutions): Ill send invite and SI shortlist by EOD.
elaine (partnerships): Great, thanks everyone. :rocket:
